Solar for Brisbane Homes

Sunpac Solar installs residential solar panel systems for Brisbane homeowners who want lower electricity bills and more control over their energy. Whether you're in a compact townhouse or a large family home with a pool, we size every system to your roof space and daily usage, not a one-size-fits-all package. Every install includes Tier-1 panels, a quality inverter, STC rebate paperwork, grid connection approval and a full handover, completed by our CEC-accredited team across Brisbane and South East Queensland.

System Size Guide

Choosing the Right System Size for Your Home

The right size depends on more than your roof. We look at four things before recommending a system, so you don't pay for panels you don't need or run short in winter.

Roof Space & Direction

North-facing space gives the most output; east/west splits suit households who use power morning and evening.

Household Energy Use

Your last few power bills show daily kWh usage, the best guide to how much solar you need.

Budget & Payback

We balance upfront cost against savings so your system pays for itself as quickly as possible.

Future Plans

Planning a battery, pool or EV? We size your inverter and panels to grow with you.

FAQ

Residential Solar FAQs

Common questions from Brisbane homeowners about going solar. Can't find your answer? Our team is happy to help.

Still have questions?

Speak with a local solar specialist, with no pressure and no obligation.

1300 552 819
01How much does residential solar cost in Brisbane?+
Our 6.6kW systems start from $2,991 after the federal STC rebate. Larger 7.7kW, 10.36kW and 13.3kW systems cost more but generate more power. We give you a fixed, itemised quote after assessing your roof.
02What is the STC rebate and how do I claim it?+
Small-scale Technology Certificates (STCs) are a federal incentive that reduces the upfront cost of solar. We apply it as a point-of-sale discount, so the price you see already includes it and there's nothing extra for you to lodge.
03What size solar system do I need?+
It depends on your daily usage, roof space and future plans such as a battery or EV. As a rough guide, 6.6kW suits smaller households, while 10kW+ suits larger families or homes with pools. Use the size finder above or ask for a free assessment.
04How long does installation take?+
Most residential installs are completed in a single day. Approvals and paperwork are handled before install day, and we'll confirm your timeframe when you accept your quote.
05Can I add a battery later?+
Yes. We can design your system to be battery-ready so adding storage later is simple. Ask about hybrid inverter options if a battery is in your plans.
06What warranties come with my system?+
Panels and inverters carry manufacturer product and performance warranties, which vary by brand, and Sunpac Solar provides a workmanship warranty on the installation. Full warranty details are included with your quote.
